The '''''Hard Liner''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] that was piloted by [[Erlick Frodar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It ferried [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to their destinations.<ref name="EJ" />
